name: wan-3-0
description:
Wan 3.0 generates video clips of 2 to 30 seconds with synchronized native audio, with Standard and Prime (faster) tiers.

Generation modes
- Text-to-video from a prompt alone
- Animate one image, or two images as first and last frame
- Reference mode: combine up to 10 images, 5 video clips, and 5 audio clips, and address them in your prompt as Image 1, Video 1, Audio 1

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
